email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 49-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their third dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 50mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-02.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Duval (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter668@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
